title: Updated Workplace Safety Advice and Measures in View of More Adverse Weather Events
what_it_is: Updated Workplace Safety Advice and Measures in View of More Adverse Weather Events

sections.label: MOM adverse weather advisory measures
sections.summary: Companies must implement measures specific to their business and safety needs, as guided by MOM's advisory on preparing for adverse weather events.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Instead, as guided by MOM's advisory on preparing for adverse weather events, companies must implement relevant measures that are specific to their business and safety needs.

sections.label: Heat stress measures and inspections
sections.summary: Employers and workers may refer to revised heat stress measures for outdoor work, and companies must demonstrate necessary measures during MOM's safety inspections.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In addition, employers and workers may refer to the revised heat stress measures for outdoor work that MOM issued in September to protect outdoor workers against heat stress.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: During MOM's regular safety inspections, companies must demonstrate that they have taken the necessary measures to mitigate workplace safety and health risks, including those arising from weather conditions.

sections.label: Migrant workers feedback via FWMOMCare
sections.summary: Migrant workers can submit feedback and concerns through MOM's FWMOMCare mobile application to reach FAST and request a call back.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Migrant workers can also submit their feedback and concerns through MOM's FWMOMCare mobile application, which is available in their native languages and use it to reach MOM's Forward Assurance and Support Teams (FAST) and request for a call back.

sections.label: Employer burden for safety guidelines
sections.summary: Employers and worksite occupiers bear the burden of ensuring workplace safety guidelines are adhered to, including a recent advisory for adverse weather conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: This is where we put the burden on the employers and the worksite occupiers to ensure that the workplace safety guidelines are all adhered to.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: This is an evolving situation, but for example, we had recently put out an advisory for preparing for adverse weather conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: And therefore, some of the recent guides that have been given to companies – as recent as September 2024 – were to, for example, monitor weather conditions via systems and alerts.

sections.label: Recently introduced heat stress materials
sections.summary: Recently introduced materials include the heat stress management compliance checklist, the advisory for preparing for adverse weather events, and WBGT monitoring guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Some of these materials that were recently introduced would be materials, such as the heat stress management compliance checklist, the advisory for preparing for adverse weather events, guidelines on wet-bulb globe temperature, or WBGT, monitoring for outdoor work.

sections.label: Post-weather hazard event checks
sections.summary: Post-weather hazard events are included to ensure post-work hazards do not affect structures and equipment that could affect operations after the weather event.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: And that also includes post-weather hazard events as well, to ensure that, post-work hazards, these do not affect structures and equipment that could affect them as they operate after the weather event.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, in short, yes, we will do that.
